item.content:encoded:
Set your own hours, take inbound banking card calls from home, and earn up to $350 in certification bonuses. The contract has a pool of 20,000+ hours of work available every month.

Earnings at a Glance

15.00–17.00 per hour, plus performance incentives
$300 certification bonus once you complete 200 productive hours
+$50 bonus if you certify within 6 weeks
Choose your own hours. Coverage runs 24/7, every day
Remote, U.S.-based, 1099 independent contractor

The Opportunity

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You’ll take inbound calls from people who rely on their cards for everyday life. They might be activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. These moments matter, and you’re the person who makes them go smoothly.

What the Work Involves

Inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions
Payments, transfers, and disputes, handled accurately and securely
Identity verification and strict security and compliance protocols on every call
Spotting potential fraud and helping resolve it with composure
Accurate documentation of every interaction

You’re a Fit If You Bring

Clear, empathetic phone communication, even when callers are stressed
Care for protecting sensitive financial information
Comfort moving between multiple systems at once
Composure and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment
Strong plus: banking, card, financial services, or contact center experience

Your Path to Starting Work

Week 1: Apply. Create your ShyftOff account and apply to the Financial Services campaign.
Weeks 2–3: Screening & credentialing. Federal background check, fingerprinting, drug screening, and credential issuance.
Weeks 4–5: Certification. Simulations and scored mock calls. Standards and examples of required work product are demonstrated.
Week 6: Practice calls & go-live. Show that your work meets the program’s accuracy and quality standards, then start choosing open hours.

Screening Cost: Please Read Before Applying

This is a federally backed program, so every contractor must complete third-party credentialing before taking live calls. As an independent contractor, you pay these providers directly:

Extensive federal background check
Fingerprinting
Drug screening
YubiKey security device (yours to keep)

Total: $299, paid to third-party providers. It’s due only when you move into credentialing, not at sign-up.

What You’ll Need

Ability to pass federal background, fingerprint, and drug screening
A quiet home workspace and reliable high-speed internet
Commitment to completing self-paced certification (about 6 weeks)

How to Apply

Create your agent account at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents
Apply to the Financial Services campaign from your dashboard

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. You set your own schedule, work remotely, and provide your own workspace and equipment.

item.content:encoded:
HTS Assist is Hopper’s agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving real customer issues like flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the largest travel brands and enterprises in the world. As Principal Product Manager, you will own the customer-facing agent end to end: the conversations, the interface, and the experience our partners put in front of millions of travelers. This is a deliberately design-leaning role, and you will be the day-to-day design decision-maker, shaping flows and interfaces directly in close partnership with partner design teams and our in-house designer.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the roadmap for the customer-facing conversational agent across chat and voice, from intent coverage and conversation design to the interfaces partners embed in their apps and websites
  • Engage enterprise partners through discovery, requirement shaping, and launch decisions, translating partner asks into product choices that keep one product serving many partners
  • Partner with Partner Solutions on implementation and onboarding
  • Drive design daily, working hands-on in Figma to produce flows and wireframes, and partner with design on high-fidelity and production assets
  • Build working prototypes using AI coding tools where they beat a written spec, to test conversation flows and interface ideas
  • Define and defend quality bars with the evaluation team, covering resolution rate, containment, escalation correctness, and conversation quality
  • Specify agent behavior in detail, including resolution, tone, escalation policy, guardrails, and edge cases, and iterate from production conversation data
  • Stay close to GTM, Partner Solutions, and Success teams, feeding what the field learns back into the roadmap

An ideal candidate has

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including principal or lead-level ownership of a customer-facing product, with conversational AI, customer experience automation, or an adjacent space strongly preferred
  • Design fluency, comfortable manipulating design files and producing flows and basic mocks solo in Figma, having operated as a de facto design lead on a lean team
  • The ability to write enough code to get a prototype working without waiting on an engineer, treating AI tools as a normal part of how they build
  • Hands-on front-end experience, having built or shipped web front ends and able to engage engineers credibly
  • Deep partner-facing experience with enterprise clients, ideally in regulated industries, shaping requirements and launch decisions at the product level
  • A data-driven approach grounded in customer service and automation metrics, including resolution, containment, CSAT, and escalation quality
  • Working familiarity with LLM-based products, including prompt and behavior design, AI quality practices, and their failure modes

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and the upsides of pre-IPO equity packages
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Carrot Cash travel stipend
  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend
  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards
  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business
  • Open communication with management and company leadership
  • Small, dynamic teams with massive impact
  • 100% employer paid Medical, Dental and Vision coverage for employees
  • Access to Disability and Life insurance
  • Health Reimbursement Account (HRA)
  • DCA/FSA and access to a 401k plan

About Hopper
At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While many know us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth: billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’s channels every year. Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus booking travel alone.

Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business. Through HTS, any travel provider, including airlines, hotels, banks, and travel agencies, can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to see millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America, and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

About the Role

HTS Assist is Hopper’s agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the world’s largest travel brands. We’re looking for a senior full stack engineer to anchor this product, owning the realtime and voice layer end to end while building across React/TypeScript front ends, Scala and Python services, and cloud infrastructure. What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the voice channel end to end, including telephony and CPaaS integrations (e.g., Twilio, Amazon Connect), streaming speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, realtime model orchestration, and latency and quality budgets
  • Build product features across the stack, including web chat front ends in React/TypeScript, backend services in Scala and Python, and infrastructure on GCP
  • Design for multi-tenant scale, with one codebase serving many partners through configuration rather than forks
  • Build the safety and compliance plumbing enterprise partners audit, including guardrails, content filtering, and PII redaction integration points
  • Keep revenue-critical deployments healthy through observability, alerting, incident response, and SLA performance
  • Build the platform capabilities forward-deployed engineers configure for partner telephony integrations and go-lives
  • Raise the engineering bar through code review, architecture reviews, and mentoring

An ideal candidate has

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with senior-level ownership of production systems and genuine full-stack range
  • Hands-on realtime systems experience, such as voice applications, WebRTC/SIP, streaming media, or comparable low-latency products
  • Strength in a modern front end (React, TypeScript) and depth on the backend (Scala or another JVM language, and/or Python), along with cloud infrastructure experience on GCP or AWS
  • A track record designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven systems
  • Familiarity using AI coding tools as a standard part of their workflow, with the judgment to review, correct, and own everything that ships

  • The ability to break down complex problems, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and ship iteratively, backed by strong communication across product, design, and operations

  • Bonus points for working knowledge of cloud telephony or CPaaS platforms such as Twilio, Amazon Connect, Genesys, or LiveKit

  • Familiarity with travel industry technologies (PSS/GDS, hotel PMS/CRS) is a plus, though not required
